newsitem.title: LEBANON: Libano-Francaise has Lebanon's top bank profits.
newsitem.headline: Libano-Francaise has Lebanon's top bank profits.

text.p: Lebanon's Banque Libano-Francaise on Friday reported a 24 percent rise in profits to 51.8 billion Lebanese pounds ($33 million) in 1996 to maintain its position as top profits-earner among Lebanon's 82 banks.

The bank increased its share capital in 1996 to 60 billion pounds from 20 billion and carried out a further increase this month to 100 billion pounds, according to annual results published in Beirut newspapers.
Assets rose 30 percent in 1996, customer deposits rose 31.7 percent and loans rose 29 percent, the bank said.
